Bibot v1.0.6 - UI refresh
Updated: 2026-11-22 | versionName 1.0.6 | versionCode 7

- One visual language: self-drawn hand-drawn vector icons, single accent #1976D2.
- Removed all Fluent Emoji 3D graphics (including the old Home tiles).
- Consistent icon set across Home, Settings and top bar; stable light/dark palette.
- Unified Bibot typography scale; smallest labels at least 12sp.
- PDF: smarter layout, even side margins, zoom no longer sticks on a page.
- Weather: choose any location by name or coordinates in Settings > Weather.
- Bug fixes and stability improvements.
